text:
**B.** With chronic drug use, the brain downregulates post-synaptic dopamine (D2) receptors. That blunts normal reward and leaves the patient needing the drug to feel normal, which fits the agitation, craving and "bad things will happen" claim. The team note that chronic use destroys dopamine neurons (option C) doesn't fit here, because cell death is not the typical mechanism of addiction, so I'm changing my earlier answer of A.

CONFIDENCE: 55
